description:
The 2025 Relaxed Body E-Bike takes everything riders loved about the original and upgrades it across the board. With a front suspension fork and integrated front and rear lights, it delivers a smoother, safer, and more comfortable ride—whether you're navigating city streets or cruising along scenic trails.

Powered by a 48V 500W motor, this bike gives you consistent, responsive acceleration without the complexity of a torque sensor. The electric assist can be activated while pedaling or by simply pressing the thumb throttle—whichever feels right for the moment. You can reach speeds of up to 20mph, making commutes and casual rides fast, easy, and fun.

The newly added front suspension fork absorbs bumps and cracks in the road, providing a much smoother ride across uneven terrain. Combined with the relaxed body geometry, it helps reduce strain on your back, shoulders, and wrists—keeping you comfortable longer.

A key highlight of this model is the unique frame design. With an ultra-low step-over height and forward pedaling setup, riders can keep the seat low while still achieving full leg extension. This makes getting on and off the bike easy and stable—ideal for riders of all heights, from 5'0" to 6'2". It’s a frame built for accessibility without sacrificing performance or comfort.

The 2025 version also includes integrated front and rear lights, so you’re visible and safe riding in low light. You won’t need to worry about adding or forgetting clip-on lights—everything is built in and ready to go. Stopping power is equally strong, thanks to the mechanical disc brakes that provide confident braking in all conditions.

The battery offers a range of up to 50 miles depending on your use of pedal assist or throttle, giving you plenty of freedom to roam without range anxiety. Whether you’re taking a leisurely ride through the neighborhood or stretching out into the countryside, this bike adapts to your rhythm and style.

With thoughtful upgrades, sleek design, and rider-friendly features throughout, the 2025 Relaxed Body E-Bike delivers a ride that’s as easygoing as it is capable.

2025 Relaxed Body E-Bike – Key Features:

48V 500W Motor for smooth, consistent power

Thumb Throttle & Pedal Assist Modes – ride your way

Up to 20mph Top Speed

Up to 50 Miles Range per charge

Front Suspension Fork for a smoother, more comfortable ride

Very Low Step-Over Frame for easy mounting and dismounting

Forward Pedaling Design allows for a low seat with full leg extension

Fits Riders from 5'0" to 6'2" comfortably

Mechanical Disc Brakes for strong, reliable stopping power

Integrated Front & Rear Lights for visibility and safety

Relaxed Body Geometry for an upright, pain-free riding posture

Sleek, Minimalist Design with functional upgrades throughout
